name: Chy vsi svity taki?
source:
Worldology is a pseudoscience that studies parallel worlds. Proponents of the idea of ​​other universes often do their own research. The general public does not take them seriously, because usually 'researchers' rely only on their own visions and feelings.

The main character, Metr, sincerely believes in the existence of other worlds, despite the condemnation from those around him, but his interest in 'science' led him to other things. The player will be able to walk this path from the Metr's perspective... or maybe together with him.

[Translated from [url=https://hernyapis.itch.io/chy-vsi-svity-taki]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“异界学”是一门研究平行世界的伪科学。笃信其他宇宙存在的人们往往各自开展研究，而大众却从不把他们当回事——因为这些所谓的“研究者”通常只拿自己的幻觉与直觉当作依据。

尽管饱受周围人的指责与嘲讽，主人公梅特尔依然由衷坚信其他世界的存在；然而他对这门“科学”的痴迷，最终却将他引向了意想不到的境地。玩家将从梅特尔的视角走过这段旅途……又或者，与他并肩同行。

[译自[url=https://hernyapis.itch.io/chy-vsi-svity-taki]itch.io[/url]]
